item.title: Re: More pages for Highest Rated Pages?
item.content:encoded:
No harm except that uncapping the query puts more strain on the database on every request, and there's no telling how often this page gets hit on a daily basis.

Might want to keep an eye on things in case it starts lagging.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Vote inflation. More members means more votes means higher ratings for good articles means more 100+ rated articles mean less space is left for anything with a lower rating.

If this page somehow gets 100+ rating, it will show itself on itself. Nothing will implode because of that. We already have the Thread that you can discuss in the Thread. Also, it will never get that rating, because people have better things to do than vote on system pages. And by better things I mean writing a skip about silly hats. Everyone is very busy with that right now.
